name: modbee-mqtt
description: Function blocks that put MQTT inside an OpenPLC program, one block per connection with the work as its methods. FB_MqttClient covers every combination - MQTT 5.0 or 3.1.1, plain or TLS, on a board over Wi-Fi, Ethernet or cellular, or on the Runtime - with Publish, Report (on change with a deadband, or on a clock), Subscribe with a data quality that says how much to believe a number, a whole STRUCT at once, MQTT 5 request and response, and option structures for the session, TLS, the board's network and the online/offline Will. A PLC can register itself with a provisioning key and keep the login it is given. FB_SparkplugNode reports a whole STRUCT to SCADA from one point list (sp.Record), each member by its class, offers Live Demand to a viewing host, keeps events through a link outage and sends them afterwards flagged historical, and publishes daily totals on every birth; FB_SparkplugHost is the other end. The PLC can be the site broker (FB_MqttBroker), and a bridge carries topics between two brokers. Every setting may change while running: the client reconnects by itself. Nothing here blocks, connect included, so a scan cycle never waits on a network. 0.2.0 replaces the 28 blocks of 0.1.x; a project on 0.1.x stays on it.
